Simulates the standalone soundcloud.com/artist/track page, which SoundCloud renders inside a same-origin webiIframe with a plain <h1> and no a.soundTitle__title anchors — see test/README.md. The URL bar is rewritten via history.replaceState below so location.pathname reports the fixture's permalink even though this is served locally.
Open devtools console — the mocks self-test on load.
